Description.LocalizedString: Issued by Pink Paws Bank, this full pouch of special coins can be exchanged for Fons. A dazzling pile of gold, staring at it for too long brings on a dizzy sense of happiness.

Description.SourceString: 瞌睡不醒？身心疲惫？VC活力饮，使您的一天活力满满！
Description.LocalizedString: Running on empty? VC Vitality keeps you energized day in and day out!

UseContext.SourceString: 「粉爪大劫案」玩法中可获得的珍稀品质道具，使用后可以恢复大量生命值，价值12000方斯。

Description.LocalizedString: Fast-acting pain relief. One pill clears any ache—from headaches to sore feet.

UseContext.SourceString: 「粉爪大劫案」玩法中可获得的基础品质道具，价值20方斯。
UseContext.LocalizedString: A Basic item obtainable in the Pink Paws Heist game mode, worth 20 Fons.

Description.LocalizedString: A diary with worn edges. You can tell it's been read countless times, its thin pages having been turned through the majority of someone's life.

Description.LocalizedString: An old photograph carrying someone's memories. Those golden days, once thought to stay vivid forever, are but a faded moment after a life long-lived.

UseContext.LocalizedString: A Common item obtainable in the Pink Paws Heist game mode, worth 640 Fons.

Description.SourceString: 外观奇特的瓷瓶，很难根据外表判断出它的用途是什么，嗯……仅供观赏怎么不算是一种用途呢？
Description.LocalizedString: A porcelain vase with a peculiar appearance. It's hard to tell what it's used for at just a glance. Hmm… but isn't being nice to look at a purpose in itself?

UseContext.SourceString: 「粉爪大劫案」玩法中可获得的普通品质道具，价值720方斯。
UseContext.LocalizedString: A Common item obtainable in the Pink Paws Heist game mode, worth 720 Fons.

Description.SourceString: 古韵悠长的青花瓷碗，在遥远的过去曾作为不可缺少的日用品构建着人们热气腾腾的生活。
Description.LocalizedString: A blue and white porcelain bowl with a timeless, classical charm. In the distant past, it served as an indispensable everyday item, a part of people's warm and vibrant lives.

UseContext.SourceString: 「粉爪大劫案」玩法中可获得的普通品质道具，价值560方斯。

UseContext.LocalizedString: A Common item obtainable in the Pink Paws Heist game mode, worth 800 Fons.

Description.SourceString: 容量巨大的镀金容器，如果放一个在家里，似乎可以将所有的杂物都收纳其中。
Description.LocalizedString: A gilded container of enormous capacity. If you kept one at home, you could store all your miscellaneous clutter inside it.

UseContext.SourceString: 「粉爪大劫案」玩法中可获得的基础品质道具，价值80方斯。
UseContext.LocalizedString: A Basic item obtainable in the Pink Paws Heist game mode, worth 80 Fons.

Description.SourceString: 似乎是记录着某次重要交易的文件，最好不要不顾封面的「绝密」打开浏览……
Description.LocalizedString: A document that seems to record an important transaction. Better not ignore the Top Secret label on the cover and flip through it…

UseContext.SourceString: 「粉爪大劫案」玩法中可获得的基础品质道具，价值60方斯。
UseContext.LocalizedString: A Basic item obtainable in the Pink Paws Heist game mode, worth 60 Fons.

Description.SourceString: 几张散落的银行文件，内容似乎是银行与某位客户签订的的贷款协议。
Description.LocalizedString: A few scattered bank documents. The contents appear to be a loan agreement signed between the bank and a certain client.

UseContext.SourceString: 「粉爪大劫案」玩法中可获得的基础品质道具，价值40方斯。
UseContext.LocalizedString: A Basic item obtainable in the Pink Paws Heist game mode, worth 40 Fons.

Description.SourceString: 一份详细的「粉爪银行柜台业务操作手册」，颇具实用价值，不慎丢失的话可以在前台再领取一份。
Description.LocalizedString: A detailed Pink Paws Bank Counter Services Operations Manual. Quite practical. If you lose it, you can always pick up another copy at the front desk.

UseContext.SourceString: 「粉爪大劫案」玩法中可获得的基础品质道具，价值20方斯。
UseContext.LocalizedString: A Basic item obtainable in the Pink Paws Heist game mode, worth 20 Fons.

Description.SourceString: 属于某位银行职员的厚厚一沓员工手册，里面的文字密密麻麻，因此具有出类拔萃的催眠效果。
Description.LocalizedString: A thick stack of employee handbooks belonging to some bank clerk. The text inside is so densely packed that it has an outstanding sleep-inducing effect.

UseContext.SourceString: 「粉爪大劫案」玩法中可获得的贵重品质道具，价值2000方斯。
UseContext.LocalizedString: A Rare item obtainable in the Pink Paws Heist game mode, worth 2,000 Fons.

Description.SourceString: 外表漆黑如墨的长颈瓶，传说曾有一位贫苦作家买不起纸笔，用烧黑的木炭在家里的瓶瓶罐罐上练习写作，久而久之瓶身黑炭竟然再也无法洗去，后来人们制作出墨染瓶以示对他的纪念。
Description.LocalizedString: A long-necked vase with an exterior as black as ink. Legend has it that a poor writer who couldn't afford paper and pen once practiced writing on household jars and bottles using charred wood. Over time, the black char became a permanent stain. People later crafted ink-stained vases to commemorate him.

UseContext.SourceString: 「粉爪大劫案」玩法中可获得的贵重品质道具，价值3000方斯。
UseContext.LocalizedString: A Rare item obtainable in the Pink Paws Heist game mode, worth 3,000 Fons.

Description.SourceString: 外表漆黑如墨的敞口罐，传说曾有一位贫苦作家买不起纸笔，用烧黑的木炭在家里的瓶瓶罐罐上练习写作，久而久之罐身黑炭竟然再也无法洗去，后来人们制作出墨染罐以示对他的纪念。
Description.LocalizedString: A wide-mouth jar with an exterior as black as ink. Legend has it that a poor writer who couldn't afford paper and pen once practiced writing on household jars and bottles using charred wood. Over time, the black char became a permanent stain. People later crafted ink-stained jars to commemorate him.

UseContext.SourceString: 「粉爪大劫案」玩法中可获得的珍稀品质道具，价值20000方斯。
UseContext.LocalizedString: An Epic item obtainable in the Pink Paws Heist mode, worth 20,000 Fons.

Description.SourceString: 历经时间洗礼后依旧寒光凛冽的长刀，出鞘之时连天上的星光都避其锋芒。
Description.LocalizedString: A long blade that retains its cold, piercing gleam even after the trials of time. When unsheathed, even the stars in the sky shy away from its sharp edge.

UseContext.SourceString: 「粉爪大劫案」玩法中可获得的珍稀品质道具，价值27500方斯。
UseContext.LocalizedString: An Epic item obtainable in the Pink Paws Heist mode, worth 27,500 Fons.

Description.SourceString: 据说是每时每刻都在向外发射某种电波的贵重仪器，对于维特海默值的波动异常敏锐，极大地方便了学者们对于一些可能存在未知异象的神秘领域的探索。
Description.LocalizedString: A high-value instrument rumored to emit constant electromagnetic waves. Highly sensitive to fluctuations in the Wertheimer Index, it has become an indispensable tool for scholars probing regions where unknown Anomalies may lurk.

UseContext.SourceString: 「粉爪大劫案」玩法中可获得的贵重品质道具，价值1500方斯。
UseContext.LocalizedString: A Rare item obtainable in the Pink Paws Heist game mode, worth 1,500 Fons.

Description.SourceString: 怀揣着与信念毫无二异的梦想，船头的水手由此望向以前从未有人到达的世界尽头。
Description.LocalizedString: Carrying dreams as steadfast as their convictions, sailors at the bow would gaze through this and glimpse the edge of the world, where none had ventured before.

UseContext.SourceString: 「粉爪大劫案」玩法中可获得的贵重品质道具，价值1500方斯。
UseContext.LocalizedString: A Rare item obtainable in the Pink Paws Heist game mode, worth 1,500 Fons.

Description.SourceString: 珍贵的纯金项链，款式独特，光泽幽雅，戴上它时仿佛是融化的月光蜿蜒在颈上。
Description.LocalizedString: A precious necklace crafted from pure gold. Its unique design and gentle sheen make it feel like melted moonlight flowing along the neck.

UseContext.SourceString: 「粉爪大劫案」玩法中可获得的珍稀品质道具，价值15000方斯。
UseContext.LocalizedString: An Epic item obtainable in the Pink Paws Heist game mode, worth 15,000 Fons.

Description.SourceString: 华美的宝石项链，入目的那一刻，会觉得世间最动人的存在也正该如此。
Description.LocalizedString: A gorgeous gemstone necklace. The moment it catches your eye, you'll feel that this is exactly what the most breathtaking thing in the world should look like.

UseContext.SourceString: 「粉爪大劫案」玩法中可获得的珍稀品质道具，价值40000方斯。
UseContext.LocalizedString: An Epic item obtainable in the Pink Paws Heist game mode, worth 40,000 Fons.

Description.SourceString: 剔透的珍珠项链，颗颗圆润的珍珠好似海底月华，就连传说中人鱼的眼泪也无法与之媲美。
Description.LocalizedString: A lustrous pearl necklace, each perfectly round pearl gleaming like moonlight on the ocean floor. Even the legendary tears of mermaids couldn't compare.

UseContext.SourceString:
「粉爪大劫案」玩法中可获得的基础品质道具，仅能使用一次，可以开启某些临时上锁的电梯门。
能够带出银行，最多同时拥有10个。
UseContext.LocalizedString:
A Basic single-use item obtainable in Pink Paws Heist. Unlocks certain temporarily locked elevator doors.
Can be taken out of the bank. Carry up to 10.

Description.SourceString: 银行专门为外来访客提供的身份卡，可以凭此卡开启楼层间的电梯。
Description.LocalizedString: An identity card issued by the bank specifically for visiting outsiders. Grants elevator access between floors.

UseContext.SourceString:
「粉爪大劫案」玩法中可获得的基础品质道具，仅能使用一次，可以开启配电箱。
能够带出银行，最多同时拥有10个。
UseContext.LocalizedString:
A Basic single-use item obtainable in Pink Paws Heist. Unlocks electrical control boxes.
Can be taken out of the bank. Carry up to 10.

Description.SourceString: 一把毫不起眼的铁灰色钥匙，用于开启配电箱。
Description.LocalizedString: An unremarkable iron-gray key used to open the electrical panel.

UseContext.SourceString:
「粉爪大劫案」玩法中可获得的普通品质道具，能够多次使用，可以开启副行长办公室的电梯。
能够带出银行，最多同时拥有10个。
UseContext.LocalizedString:
A Common multiple-use item obtainable in Pink Paws Heist. Unlocks elevators leading to the vice president's office.
Can be taken out of the bank. Carry up to 10.

Description.SourceString: 副行长的权限卡，可以用它乘坐副行长专用电梯。
Description.LocalizedString: A clearance card that grants access to the bank's vice president-only elevator.

UseContext.SourceString:
「粉爪大劫案」玩法中与「混沌谜核」一起使用可以开启银行最为宏伟的金库大门，仅可使用一次。
能够带出银行，最多同时拥有3个。
UseContext.LocalizedString:
「粉爪大劫案」玩法中与「混沌谜核」一起使用可以开启银行最为宏伟的金库大门，仅可使用一次。
能够带出银行，最多同时拥有3个。

Description.SourceString: 管理员才能持有的高级权限卡，可以开启最大的金库大门。
Description.LocalizedString: An advanced clearance card exclusive to administrators. Grants access to the largest vault.

UseContext.SourceString: 「粉爪大劫案」玩法中可以开启收藏楼层的管理员房间，仅可使用一次。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Unlocks the admin room on the collection floor in the Pink Paws Heist game mode. Single use only.

Description.SourceString: 管理员才能持有的高级权限卡，是开启最大金库的钥匙之一
Description.LocalizedString: An advanced clearance card exclusive to administrators. Grants access as one of the keys to the largest vault.

「粉爪大劫案」玩法中可获得的珍稀品质道具，仅能使用一次，可以开启1号金库。
能够带出银行，最多同时拥有5个。
UseContext.LocalizedString:
An Epic single-use item obtainable in Pink Paws Heist. Unlocks Vault No. 1.
Can be taken out of the bank. Carry up to 5.

Description.SourceString: 1号金库的门禁卡，可以打开银行的普通金库，里面通常会有零星的保险箱。
Description.LocalizedString: Grants access to Vault No. 1, a standard bank vault that usually contains a few safe deposit boxes.

「粉爪大劫案」玩法中可获得的珍稀品质道具，仅能使用一次，可以开启2号金库。

UseContext.LocalizedString:
An Epic single-use item obtainable in the Pink Paws Heist game mode. Unlocks Vault No. 2.
Can be taken out of the bank. Carry up to 5.

Description.SourceString: 2号金库的门禁卡，可以打开经常会租赁给不同的客户的金库，里面通常会有一些保险箱。
Description.LocalizedString: Grants access to Vault No. 2, frequently rented out to various clients and typically containing several safety deposit boxes.

UseContext.SourceString:
「粉爪大劫案」玩法中可获得的珍稀品质道具，仅能使用一次，可以开启3号金库。

UseContext.LocalizedString:
An Epic single-use item obtainable in the Pink Paws Heist game mode. Unlocks Vault No. 3.
Can be taken out of the bank. Carry up to 5.

Description.SourceString: 3号金库的门禁卡，可以打开隶属于银行高层人士的金库，说不定能在其中找到其他房间的门禁卡。
Description.LocalizedString: Grants access to Vault No. 3, owned by a senior member of the bank. You might even find access cards for other rooms inside.

UseContext.SourceString:
「粉爪大劫案」玩法中可获得的珍稀品质道具，仅能使用一次，可以开启4号金库。

UseContext.LocalizedString:
An Epic single-use item obtainable in the Pink Paws Heist game mode. Unlocks Vault No. 4.

Description.LocalizedString: Grants access to Vault No. 4, one of the bank's most commonly used vaults, usually holding loose stacks of cash.

UseContext.SourceString:
「粉爪大劫案」玩法中可获得的珍稀品质道具，仅能使用一次，可以开启5号金库。
能够带出银行，最多同时拥有5个。
UseContext.LocalizedString:
An Epic single-use item obtainable in the Pink Paws Heist game mode. Unlocks Vault No. 5.
Can be taken out of the bank. Carry up to 5.

Description.SourceString: 5号金库的门禁卡，可以打开用以储蓄银行日常资金的金库，或许能在里面找到不少纸钞。
Description.LocalizedString: Grants access to Vault No. 5, used to store the bank's daily operating funds. You may find a sizable amount of cash inside.

UseContext.SourceString:
「粉爪大劫案」玩法中可获得的珍稀品质道具，仅能使用一次，可以开启6号金库。
能够带出银行，最多同时拥有5个。
UseContext.LocalizedString:
An Epic single-use item obtainable in the Pink Paws Heist game mode. Unlocks Vault No. 6.
Can be taken out of the bank. Carry up to 5.

Description.SourceString: 6号金库的门禁卡，可以打开贮存有大量备用钱币的金库，或许能在里面找到数量可观的纸钞。
Description.LocalizedString: Grants access to Vault No. 6, which stores a large reserve of backup currency. Considerable amounts of cash may be found inside.

UseContext.SourceString:
「粉爪大劫案」玩法中可获得的珍稀品质道具，仅能使用一次，可以开启7号金库。
能够带出银行，最多同时拥有5个。
UseContext.LocalizedString:
An Epic single-use item obtainable in the Pink Paws Heist game mode. Unlocks Vault No. 7.
Can be taken out of the bank. Carry up to 5.

Description.SourceString: 7号金库的门禁卡，可以打开属于某个有名权贵的金库，据说其中珍藏有诸如青花花瓶之类的古董珍品。
Description.LocalizedString: Grants access to Vault No. 7, belonging to a well-known and influential figure. Rumored to house rare antiques such as Blue and White Porcelain Vases.

UseContext.SourceString:
「粉爪大劫案」玩法中可获得的珍稀品质道具，仅能使用一次，可以开启8号金库。
能够带出银行，最多同时拥有5个。
UseContext.LocalizedString:
An Epic single-use item obtainable in the Pink Paws Heist game mode. Unlocks Vault No. 8.
Can be taken out of the bank. Carry up to 5.

Description.SourceString: 8号金库的门禁卡，可以打开存放着一位富豪收藏品的金库，据说其中珍藏有诸如青花花瓶之类的古董珍品。
Description.LocalizedString: Grants access to Vault No. 8, which stores a wealthy collector's private collection. Rumored to include valuable antiques such as Blue and White Porcelain Vase.

UseContext.SourceString:
「粉爪大劫案」玩法中可获得的珍稀品质道具，仅能使用一次，可以开启9号金库。
能够带出银行，最多同时拥有5个。
UseContext.LocalizedString:
An Epic single-use item obtainable in the Pink Paws Heist game mode. Unlocks Vault No. 9.
Can be taken out of the bank. Carry up to 5.

Description.SourceString: 9号金库的门禁卡，可以打开不知属于何人的金库，传言里面珍藏有诸如凝华海露之类的名贵珠宝。
Description.LocalizedString: Grants access to Vault No. 9, whose owner remains unknown. Legends claim it contains rare jewels such as Oceanic Dewdrops.

UseContext.SourceString:
「粉爪大劫案」玩法中可获得的珍稀品质道具，仅能使用一次，可以开启10号金库。
能够带出银行，最多同时拥有5个。
UseContext.LocalizedString:
An Epic single-use item obtainable in the Pink Paws Heist game mode. Unlocks Vault No. 10.
Can be taken out of the bank. Carry up to 5.

Description.SourceString: 10号金库的门禁卡，可以打开一座罕为人知的神秘金库，至今尚无人知晓里面藏有何等的珍奇。
Description.LocalizedString: Grants access to Vault No. 10, a little-known and mysterious vault. To this day, no one knows what treasures lie inside.

UseContext.SourceString:
「粉爪大劫案」玩法中可获得的珍稀品质道具，仅能使用一次，能与「高级权限卡.一」一起使用可以开启银行最为宏伟的金库大门。
能够带出银行，最多同时拥有2个。
UseContext.LocalizedString:
An Epic single-use item obtainable in Pink Paws Heist. Used with Advanced Clearance Card I to unlock the gate to the bank's most magnificent vault.
Can be taken out of the bank. Carry up to 2.

Description.SourceString: 原本似乎是某种器物的核心，如今却失去了最初的辉光。孤独的秘藏被看守在收藏室的深处，期盼着终有一日能被安置到正确的地方。
Description.LocalizedString: Once the core of an unknown device, now stripped of its original glow. Guarded deep within the collection vault, this lonely relic waits for the day it can be placed where it truly belongs.

UseContext.SourceString:
「粉爪大劫案」玩法中可获得的普通品质道具，仅能使用一次，可以开启办公层娱乐室的门。
能够带出银行，最多同时拥有5个。
UseContext.LocalizedString:
A Common single-use item obtainable in Pink Paws Heist. Unlocks the door to the Recreation Room on the Office Floor.
Can be taken out of the bank. Carry up to 5.

Description.SourceString: 凭此卡可以进入银行员工经常使用的娱乐室，稍微留心的话会发现似乎总有人在里面遗落一些东西……
Description.LocalizedString: Grants access to the bank staff's recreation room. If you pay attention, you might notice things left behind…

UseContext.SourceString:
「粉爪大劫案」玩法中可获得的普通品质道具，仅能使用一次，可以开启收藏层会议室的门。
能够带出银行，最多同时拥有5个。
UseContext.LocalizedString:
A Common single-use item obtainable in Pink Paws Heist. Unlocks the door to the Meeting Room on the Collection Floor.
Can be taken out of the bank. Carry up to 5.

Description.SourceString: 凭此卡可以进入收藏层角落的会议室，根据里面直通副行长办公室的电梯来看，这间会议室似乎是专属于某人的。
Description.LocalizedString: Grants access to a corner meeting room on the Collection Floor, with an elevator leading directly to the vice president's office, suggesting it's reserved for someone in particular.

UseContext.SourceString:
「粉爪大劫案」玩法中可获得的贵重品质道具，仅能使用一次，可以开启办公层副经理办公室的门。
能够带出银行，最多同时拥有3个。
UseContext.LocalizedString:
A Rare single-use item obtainable in Pink Paws Heist. Unlocks the door to the Assistant Manager Office on the Office Floor.
Can be taken out of the bank. Carry up to 3.

Description.SourceString: 凭此卡可以进入办公层副经理办公室，里面说不定会存放有一些保险箱之类的物件。
Description.LocalizedString: Grants access to the Assistant Manager's office on the Office Floor, which may contain items like safes.

UseContext.SourceString:
「粉爪大劫案」玩法中可获得的贵重品质道具，仅能使用一次，可以开启收藏层配电间的门。
能够带出银行，最多同时拥有3个。
UseContext.LocalizedString:
A Rare single-use item obtainable in Pink Paws Heist. Unlocks the door to the Electrical Room on the Collection Floor.
Can be taken out of the bank. Carry up to 3.

Description.SourceString: 凭此卡可以进入收藏层配电间……等等，你去那里做什么？
Description.LocalizedString: Grants access to the Collection Floor electrical room… Wait, what are you planning to do there?

UseContext.SourceString:
「粉爪大劫案」玩法中可获得的贵重品质道具，仅能使用一次，可以开启收藏层监控室的门。
能够带出银行，最多同时拥有3个。
UseContext.LocalizedString:
A Rare single-use item obtainable in Pink Paws Heist. Unlocks the door to the Security Room on the Collection Floor.
Can be taken out of the bank. Carry up to 3.

Description.SourceString: 凭此卡可以进入收藏层监控室，话说回来，监控室里有那么大一个保险箱是正常的吗……
Description.LocalizedString: Grants access to the Collection Floor security room. But why is there such a huge safe inside?

UseContext.SourceString:
「粉爪大劫案」玩法中可获得的珍稀品质道具，仅能使用一次，可以开启办公层经理办公室的门。
能够带出银行，最多同时拥有2个。
UseContext.LocalizedString:
